snippet.title: House of Legacy Is Out Now in Early Access! | Build Your Legacy in Ancient China
snippet.description:
Take on the role of a clan elder and guide your family across generations — managing estates, forging alliances, and navigating the shifting tides of politics and war. Will your family rise to glory or fade into history?

Early Access Version:

Expanded Scale:
- 12 unique cities plus the imperial capital as the power center
- Nearly 30 interactive noble families, allowing deeper cooperation and rivalries
- Over 200 unlockable building components
- No time limits — build a dynasty that lasts a millennium
- Fully customizable names for characters, estates, farms, and more

Expanded Gameplay: 
Officialdom System:
- Govern counties, manage taxation, and operate fiefs
- Appoint, impeach, or dismiss officials
- Pursue a military career and earn honors through merit

Imperial Court System:
- Befriend the royal family, spread rumors, or assassinate the king and crown a new ruler
- New capital-specific positions available, including civil officials and commanders of the royal guard

Experience Improvements:
- Efficiency Boosts: Assign duties to clan members, enjoy new matchmaking features, interact with retainers, view your family tree, and input values manually when needed.
- Blueprint System: Import or export layouts for buildings and farmland with a single click
- Visual & Art Updates: Updated various art assets including UI; New city character filter function added, with building name display support

🎮 Play now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2503770/House_of_Legacy/
